purpose: Numerical baseline for INSA-ID-E1. Contains or binds every value needed to reproduce C20 without judgment after execution begins (per proposal v5.1 §7). Includes: (1) exact source locked scorebook SHAs (the four BIB scorebooks), (2) exact 85-observation inclusion mapping, (3) per-evaluator calibrated 4-d reference vector, (4) exact method for computing per-reconstruction Arm-C Manhattan statistics, (5) exact historical C20 envelope/boundary values, (6) explicit Boolean C20 PASS/FAIL formula, (7) deterministic derivation/verification script (hashing/c20-derivation.py).

evaluator_A.derivation_method: mean of 85 envelope observations per dimension

evaluator_B.derivation_method: mean of 85 envelope observations per dimension

C20_envelope_bounds.evaluator_A: TBD (computed deterministically by hashing/c20-derivation.py at preflight from the 85 envelope records)
C20_envelope_bounds.evaluator_B: TBD (computed deterministically by hashing/c20-derivation.py at preflight from the 85 envelope records)
C20_envelope_bounds.computation_method: For each evaluator, compute max per-(R, B) mean 4-dim Manhattan distance across the 85 envelope records; this is the historical envelope boundary that an in-spec Arm-C must satisfy on its own. Reproducible via hashing/c20-derivation.py with --verify-only (preflight) or full run (Phase 2).

C20_method_for_arm_C_per_reconstruction_.step_1: For each evaluator independently, compute the per-evaluator 4-dim reference vector = mean of the 85 envelope observations per dimension (above).
C20_method_for_arm_C_per_reconstruction_.step_2: For each Arm-C candidate, compute per-candidate 4-dim Manhattan distance = sum over the 4 dimensions of |candidate_score - reference_vector[dim]|.
C20_method_for_arm_C_per_reconstruction_.step_3: For each (R, B) cell in the envelope (envelope_cells set), compute the mean Manhattan distance across all Arm-C candidates in that cell.
C20_method_for_arm_C_per_reconstruction_.step_4: C20 PASS for evaluator e IF AND ONLY IF: (a) every envelope (R, B) cell has at least one Arm-C candidate (missing_cells empty), AND (b) for every (R, B) Arm-C cell, mean Manhattan distance <= C20_envelope_bound[e].
C20_method_for_arm_C_per_reconstruction_.step_5: C20 joint PASS iff both evaluators PASS. C20 fail -> disposition = INVALID_EXPERIMENT.

C20_boolean_pass_fail_formula: C20(e) = (missing_cells[e] is empty) AND (max over (R, B) of mean_4dim_Manhattan_Arm_C(R, B) <= envelope_bound[e])  // for each evaluator e in {A, B}; C20_joint = C20(A) AND C20(B).
